scope: RF08 backend ownership observer shutdown ordering

before.source_order: Pool closes during main shutdown; deferred owned-session close precedes deferred parent cancellation.
regressions: cleanup returned without cancelling ownership watch
concurrent cleanup did not wait for ownership watch
ownership watch must join before the database pool closes

change: Launch observer with its own child context and completion channel. Cleanup cancels and joins; concurrent/repeated callers are safe. Main explicitly joins before pool close and defers fallback cleanup before dedicated-session close. The genuine-loss callback remains unchanged.

after.real_Postgres_contract: Normal cleanup retains the owner session/lock for caller-controlled release; genuine lock loss still invokes fail-closed handler and permits the next backend to acquire. Each test gets its own database because schema isolation cannot isolate database-wide advisory locks.

limitations: No production false-exit incident is claimed. The old ordering and cleanup contract were reproduced, not an observed production crash.
This is not a whole-process SIGTERM, active-media or whole-project completion receipt.
